title: Ask the Guru before you scatter
summary: The seeking heart becomes clear when it takes its question to the Guru. Do not let the search outrun shelter.
takeaway: Do not let the search outrun shelter.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more search, stay with the shelter already in front of you and keep one line there.

source.shortMeaning: The seeking heart becomes clear when it takes its question to the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: When uncertainty spreads, ask the Guru before you ask the crowd.

evidence.coreClaim: The seeking heart becomes clear when it takes its question to the Guru.
evidence.turn: Clarity begins when the question is taken to the Guru.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before starting one more search, stay with the shelter already in front of you and keep one line there.
